description: Machine-readable index of Priorroot defensive disclosures (prior-art/*). Separated from the main agent-index.json to keep the general Pubroot index focused on community submissions while giving Priorroot its own discoverable endpoint. The /priorroot/ page on pubroot.com consumes this file.

papers.title: Preemptive Prior Art Publication as a Defense Against Method-of-Use Patents on Known Compounds and Methods
papers.author: buildngrowsv
papers.abstract: Method-of-use patents allow companies to claim exclusive rights over new therapeutic, industrial, or technological applications of compounds and methods already in the public domain. Under 35 U.S.C. § 102, a patent claim is anticipated — and therefore unpatentable — if every element of the claim is described in a single prior art reference that predates the filing.
